title: Investigate of LOC101928988 Regulatory Effect on the DAPK2 Transcription in Breast Tumors.
authors: Saberiyan, Mohammadreza; Ghasemi, Nazila; Jafari, Negar; Sadeghi, Mahboubeh; Ghaderi, Abbas; Mousavi, Pegah
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过临床样本表达分析和简单对接预测，探讨LOC101928988对DAPK2转录的调控，但缺乏TF-DNA互作建模和AI/物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The World Health Organization has mentioned breast cancer holds the highest incidence rate among all types of cancer globally. Death-associated protein kinase 2 (DAPK2) is a serine/threonine kinase linked to various forms of malignancy, such as breast cancer. This protein assumes a pivotal function in a multitude of cellular mechanisms, including apoptosis, autophagy, and cell migration. AIMS: This study aimed to study the LOC101928988 regulatory effect on the DAPK2 expression in breast cancer. METHODS: In this study, 38 paired tumoral and normal tissues were selected from patients. Quantitative real-time PCR was used to analyze the expression of DAPK2 and LOC101928988. The interactions of DAPK2 and its intermediate elements with LOC101928988 were predicted by docking analysis. RESULTS: The expression of DAPK2 and LOC101928988 was downregulated in tumor tissues compared to the control group. Further analysis revealed a significant positive correlation between DAPK2 and LOC101928988 levels in tumoral and adjacent normal tissues. A comparison of gene expression between different grades, stages, and HER2 statuses showed significant findings. ROC curve analysis of DAPK2 and LOC101928988 expression revealed 77% and 72% AUC for BC tissue, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Overall, our results suggest that alterations in the levels of DAPK2 and LOC101928988 may be involved in tumor initiation and progression in breast cancer. It has also been reported that LOC101928988 probably has a role in regulating DAPK2 expression through interaction with transcription factors.
abstract_zh: 背景：世界卫生组织指出，乳腺癌在全球所有癌症类型中发病率最高。死亡相关蛋白激酶2（DAPK2）是一种丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，与多种恶性肿瘤（如乳腺癌）相关。该蛋白在多种细胞机制中发挥关键作用，包括细胞凋亡、自噬和细胞迁移。目的：本研究旨在探讨LOC101928988对乳腺癌中DAPK2表达的调控作用。方法：本研究选取了38对来自患者的肿瘤组织和正常组织。采用实时定量PCR分析DAPK2和LOC101928988的表达。通过对接分析预测DAPK2及其中间元件与LOC101928988的相互作用。结果：与对照组相比，肿瘤组织中DAPK2和LOC101928988的表达下调。进一步分析显示，在肿瘤组织和相邻正常组织中，DAPK2与LOC101928988水平之间存在显著正相关。对不同分级、分期和HER2状态的基因表达进行比较，发现了显著结果。DAPK2和LOC101928988表达的ROC曲线分析显示，乳腺癌组织的AUC分别为77%和72%。结论：总体而言，我们的结果表明，DAPK2和LOC101928988水平的改变可能参与乳腺癌的肿瘤发生和进展。此外，研究还报道LOC101928988可能通过与转录因子的相互作用在调控DAPK2表达中发挥作用。
